maya-p: FYI opened a PR to change the model-catalog card for AuroraXL embeddings. The supported context note still says 'up to 8k' but our long-run bench shows quality drop after ~6k tokens. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/4920
chris-w: thanks — can you paste the bench numbers here? is it throughput or quality?
maya-p: mostly quality (cosine drift on embeddings). Quick summary: 0-4k baseline, 4k-6k small degradation, 6k+ noticeable dropoff in recall for our eval set. Throughput stable until 8k but embeddings become less useful for nearest-neighbor ranking.
taylor: do we know if it's model internals (positional extrapolation) or runtime padding/truncation?
maya-p: looked at logs — runtime sends whole sequence, no truncation. Suspect model positional embedding behavior. We also confirmed same pattern on hosted and dedicated.
chris-w: ok. Proposal: change "recommended" to 6k for embeddings and add a short note under "compatibility/limits" explaining quality vs latency tradeoff + link to the bench csv.
maya-p: filed PR with bench csv and a short blurb. Also added a small SDK snippet demonstrating chunked embedding for long docs.
chris-w: can you paste the SDK snippet so docs review can eyeball?
maya-p: sure:
```python
# chunking example for long-doc embeddings
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")

def chunked_embed(text, chunk_size=2048):
    chunks = [text[i:i+chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(text), chunk_size)]
    embeds = [client.embeddings.create(input=c) for c in chunks]
    # simple average pooling as fallback
    return sum(embeds) / len(embeds)

# usage
vec = chunked_embed(long_document)
```

taylor: nice. two suggestions: use streaming where available, and call out that simple average pooling is a heuristic — add link to the eval notebook for better aggregation methods.
maya-p: will add link to eval notebook and mention hybrid aggregation (idf-weighted) as an option.
chris-w: small nit — in the model card example you still reference the old SDK param `model_name` instead of `model`. can we update that snippet before merging?
maya-p: good catch, fixing now.

anita: i'll take the link warnings — looks like one internal link used an old anchor. will replace with the new eval-notebook anchor and add a redirect in the docs site config.
chris-w: also add a short migration note in the top-level catalog changelog about the 6k recommendation for embeddings and mention the SDK snippet change. ops and platform teams should be able to route customers to Dedicated if they need sustained 8k-quality embeddings.
maya-p: added changelog entry and a one-line note under "compatibility" about fallback routing.
anita: merging once the SDK snippet is updated and we fix the two small anchor links. I'll patch the anchors in a follow-up commit after the merge if needed.

maya-p: I'll add a metadata bump in the PR.
chris-w: perfect. thanks for moving quickly on this — looks good to me. :thumbsup:
maya-p: thanks all, merging after the snippet fix.
